title: Add the no-source-shape-tests line to the shared coder-test-execution skill and the testing review lens
outcome: The shared coder-test-execution skill (.agents/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md, step 2) and TermAl's testing review lens (.claude/reviewers/testing.md) each carry Kimi's agreed one-line rule. It says to test observable behaviour, not the text or shape of the implementation, and to stop reviewers from requesting source-shape guards. The skill line is byte-identical to Engram's copy. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are NOT changed, per Greg, and no new gate is added.
acceptance: Step 2 of .agents/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md has this text appended at its end, verbatim, with no new numbered step: "A test proves behaviour by running the code. Don't assert on the text or shape of the code (source scans, line or size caps, counts, layout); if something needs protecting, check its effect at run time. Running a source-processing tool on fixtures is behaviour, and `source_id` only binds a result to its input; neither is such a test." No other change to the skill.

The .claude/reviewers/testing.md lens gains this bullet, verbatim: "- Report a test that asserts on implementation text or shape instead of runtime behavior; do not request such a guard (`source_id` is exempt)." No other change. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are unchanged.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
